ModMetaData.name: Beamwire
ModMetaData.author: Beamwire contributors
ModMetaData.description:
Wireless power over laser beams.
Build a beam emitter on one grid and a beam receiver on another, and the power flows between them through the air with no conduit in between. Bend beams with mirrors that turn in 22.5° steps, so beams can travel diagonally as well as straight. Split them with half-silvered splitters that share power according to demand, and carry them across the map with relays.
Features - 5 nodes: emitter, receiver, mirror, splitter and relay - Beams in 8 directions; mirrors turn beams by 45°, 90°, 135° or straight back - Emitters only draw what the receivers need. A little power is lost at each bounce and over distance. - Walls and rock block beams. Fog, rain and smoke dim them, and roofs optionally block them. - Powered beams burn anyone in their path. You can turn this off, or route beams through your killbox. - Optics gather dust and need cleaning. Explosions can knock mirrors out of alignment. - Thin, glowing laser visuals and an emitter hum - Its own research tab: Beam optics, Beam splitting and Coherent relays - Compatible with Vanilla Expanded power mods (Beamwire uses the vanilla power net) and Combat Extended
